In the city I have debt and in the place I have debt - in the alley I have debt and in the house I have debt. So about debt everywhere.

In the neck of a male lion there is a loan like a chain - and in the mouth of a black snake there is a loan chain. So about debt as a chain.

Option 4: "بگفتا گر به سر یابیش خشنود - بگفت از گردن این وام افکنم زود"

He said if you find it at the head you are satisfied - he said from the neck of this loan I will throw it away soon. Not sure.
